identification: RAOB (Royal Antediluvian Order of Buffaloes) Order of Merit / Knight of Merit (KOM) jewel with red collar ribbon, enamelled oval 'Sir Arthur Ryan' badge and 1st Degree (13.7.40) and 2nd Degree (20.2.43) bars. Reverse engraved to Bro Arthur Ryan KOM, GLT for GLE, 13.3.48. Maker mark WR and 9CT on the cross, so the cross is 9ct gold; bars and oval badge look gilt and are unmarked in photos. Title date 20.02.1945 is wrong, photo reads 20.2.43. Weight not given.
